units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:2">Shebi. IX, 2</cite> <he>גליל העליון</he> … <he>והע׳</he> Upper Galilee, Lower Galilee, and the (Galilean) valley; <he>תחום טבריא הע׳</he> the district of Tiberias is the valley (of Galilee). Tosef. ib. VII, 10 <he>ההר והע׳ והשפלה</he> the mountain land, the valley, and the lowland. Ib. <he>אוכלין מבהר על שבע׳</he> (in the Sabbatical year) you may eat the mountain fruits as long as the same kind is still to be had in the valleys. Ib. <he>הר והורו ע׳ ועִמְקוֹ וכ׳</he> mountain land and an elevation on it, a valley and a depression in it, lowland and a lower plain in it (are respectively subject to the same laws); Y. ib. X, 38ᵈ bot. (corr. acc.). Ib. <he>מלוד עד הים ע׳</he> from Lydda to the sea is the valley (of Judæa), v. <cite ref="U01776"><he>שְׁפֵלָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲמָקִים</he>. Ib. <he>סימן לע׳ תמרים</he> the presence of palms indicates valleys; Tosef. l. c. <he>סימן לע׳ דקלים</he>.

senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. ʿEmeḳ, in the district of Tyre.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:9">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 9</cite> (Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ top <cite ref="A01999"><he>אמון</he></cite>).
